pages.text: Finish your Tier 4 set before stepping into these arenas — this is the hardest content in the pack. The Aether, the End and the Ultimate Wither all punish under-preparation.

$(bold)Ender Dragon$() — Drops: $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Waking Lichblade$(/l) (25% — highest in the pack), Dragon Heart, Dragon Scale.$(br2)$(bold)The Aether's dungeon bosses$() — the Slider (Bronze Dungeon): $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Thunderbrand$(/l); the Valkyrie Queen (Silver): $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Caelestis$(/l); the Sun Spirit (Gold): $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Sunfire$(/l) and the Sunfeather Charm relic. Each also drops Rift Shards.$(br2)$(bold)Botania Gaia Guardian$() — Summoned Botania capstone. Drops: $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Magiblade$(/l) (20%), Gaia Spirit Fragment. $(l:icraft:bosses/boss_overview)Scales with your kills$(/l).

$(bold)The Ultimate Wither$() (optional) — the strongest Wither; it only forms in the Nether.$(br2)Craft $(bold)Corrupted Soul Sand$() (soul sand or soul soil + 3 Nether Stars, Tier 4). Build the Wither's T with it in the centre of the arms, then set the three skulls. Elsewhere the corruption is refused and your blocks stay.

$(bold)The Ultimate Wither$(), the fight$(br2)3,000 health, heavy armour, skull storms, charges and minions.$(br2)Drops 5 Nether Stars, 2 Netherite Upgrade templates and 3,000 experience, with the Wither's usual spoils. Fought by two or more players, it drops a plain Wither's loot bag for each player instead.$(br2)Quest: $(italic)Challenge: The Ultimate Wither$().

$(bold)The Aether's apex$() — the Eye of the Storm (Brass Dungeon). Drops: $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Flamewind$(/l) (18%), T4 boss materials.$(br2)$(bold)The Abyss$() — 6 bosses across The Abyss: The Other Side, each carrying its own unique.$(br2)$(bold)Stalwart Dungeons T3+$() — Shelterer, Nether Keeper, Awful Ghast.$(br2)$(bold)Next: start with the Ender Dragon — best unique odds in the pack, and Terramity's relocated Virtue and Sorceress Circe wait beyond.$()
